rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the infectious agent itself.

example.traditional: 呢種病毒好快就傳開喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 beng6 duk6 hou2 faai3 zau6 cyun4 hoi1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the virus infects computers or spreads through digital files and networks.

example.english: My computer got a virus, and none of the files will open.
example.traditional: 我部電腦中咗電腦病毒，啲文件都開唔到。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 din6 nou5 zung3 zo2 din6 nou5 beng6 duk6 di1 man4 gin6 dou1 hoi1 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use this for an illness caused by a virus rather than for the infectious agent itself.

example.english: He has a fever this time, and the doctor says it is a virus infection.
example.traditional: 佢今次發燒，醫生話係病毒感染。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 ci3 faat3 siu1 ji1 saang1 waa6 hai6 beng6 duk6 gam2 jim5
